The collect truncation FAIL at bunker-qa.sh:3035 has TWO independent causes, and the AC as written fixes only one: (1) the documented spacing one - the pattern '"cell":"chaos-errorpath"' cannot match the agent writer's spaced json.dumps output '"cell": "chaos-errorpath"' (writer: bunker-qa.sh:987); (2) LATENT and fatal - the line is `LAST_CELL_SEEN=$(printf '%s' "$tmp" | grep -c ...)` where $tmp is a `mktemp` FILE PATH (set at bunker-qa.sh:2964): it greps the PATH STRING, so NO pattern can ever match, spacing-tolerant or not. A fix that only replaces the literal with a spacing-tolerant pattern STILL grades every completed battery TRUNCATED. Correct fix: read the file, e.g. `grep -cE '"cell": *"chaos-errorpath"' "$tmp"`.
